<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class LdapAuthController extends Controller
{
    private $ldapConnection;
    private $baseDn;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->ldapConnection = ldap_connect(config('ldap.host'), config('ldap.port'));
        $this->baseDn = config('ldap.base_dn');
        ldap_set_option($this->ldapConnection, LDAP_OPT_PROTOCOL_VERSION, 3);
        ldap_set_option($this->ldapConnection, LDAP_OPT_REFERRALS, 0);
    }

    /**
     * Authenticate user via LDAP directory lookup.
     * Used internally for SSO bridge between legacy systems.
     */
    public function authenticate(Request $request)
    {
        $username = $request->input('username');
        $password = $request->input('password');
        $domain = $request->input('domain', 'corp');

        // Basic input length check
        if (strlen($username) > 64 || strlen($password) > 128) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Input too long'], 400);
        }

        // Check for null bytes only
        if (strpos($username, "\x00") !== false) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Invalid characters'], 400);
        }

        $filter = "(&(objectClass=user)(sAMAccountName={$username})(domain={$domain}))";

        Log::info('LDAP lookup', ['filter_base' => 'sAMAccountName=' . substr($username, 0, 3) . '***']);

        try {
            $searchResult = ldap_search(
                $this->ldapConnection,
                $this->baseDn,
                $filter,
                ['cn', 'mail', 'memberOf', 'distinguishedName']
            );

            if (!$searchResult) {
                return response()->json(['error' => 'Search failed'], 500);
            }

            $entries = ldap_get_entries($this->ldapConnection, $searchResult);

            if ($entries['count'] === 0) {
                return response()->json(['error' => 'User not found'], 404);
            }

            $userDn = $entries[0]['distinguishedname'][0];

            // Attempt bind with user credentials
            $bindResult = @ldap_bind($this->ldapConnection, $userDn, $password);

            if (!$bindResult) {
                return response()->json(['error' => 'Invalid credentials'], 401);
            }

            $groups = [];
            if (isset($entries[0]['memberof'])) {
                for ($i = 0; $i < $entries[0]['memberof']['count']; $i++) {
                    $groups[] = $entries[0]['memberof'][$i];
                }
            }

            return response()->json([
                'authenticated' => true,
                'user' => [
                    'cn' => $entries[0]['cn'][0],
                    'mail' => $entries[0]['mail'][0] ?? null,
                    'groups' => $groups,
                ],
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('LDAP error', ['message' => $e->getMessage()]);
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Authentication service error'], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Lookup user details for profile display.
     */
    public function lookup(Request $request)
    {
        $email = $request->input('email');

        if (empty($email) || !filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Valid email required'], 400);
        }

        // Email is validated as proper format, construct filter
        $filter = "(&(objectClass=person)(mail={$email}))";

        $searchResult = ldap_search(
            $this->ldapConnection,
            $this->baseDn,
            $filter,
            ['cn', 'title', 'department', 'telephoneNumber']
        );

        if (!$searchResult) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Lookup failed'], 500);
        }

        $entries = ldap_get_entries($this->ldapConnection, $searchResult);

        if ($entries['count'] === 0) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Not found'], 404);
        }

        return response()->json([
            'cn' => $entries[0]['cn'][0],
            'title' => $entries[0]['title'][0] ?? '',
            'department' => $entries[0]['department'][0] ?? '',
        ]);
    }
}

environment.description: Same Laravel application on EC2, but origin is NOT publicly accessible. Traffic is served exclusively through a CloudFront distribution configured with signed URL enforcement (TrustedKeyGroups policy with RSA-2048 key pair, requiring valid Signature, Key-Pair-Id, and Expires query parameters on every request). The origin is protected by a custom header secret (X-Origin-Verify) checked by the ALB listener rule — requests without the matching header value receive 403. CloudFront's origin request policy injects this header. Additionally, the CloudFront distribution has a cache behavior with viewer-request Lambda@Edge function that validates the signed URL parameters before forwarding. The EC2 security group only allows inbound from CloudFront's published IP ranges (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing prefix list). Without a valid signed URL (generated server-side with 60-second TTL for authenticated admin sessions only), no request reaches the application.

origin_protection.alb_listener_rule: IF header X-Origin-Verify != expected THEN fixed-response 403

lambda_edge.function: validates Signature, Key-Pair-Id, Expires params; rejects expired or invalid signatures
